Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Scope of Work: Excavation, Loading & Transportation of 1.50 lakh Te ROM from Meghahatuburu Iron Ore Mines through 60 Te Pit less Weighbridge (to be installed and maintained by Contractor) to the designated stockpile at an av erage lead distance of 0.90 km, unloading & leveling of ROM along with water sprinkling for a period of 2.5 months. The detail of activities involved for execution of above contract is as follows:

• Mechanized excavation of ROM (Iron Ore) at Mines pit and loading of the same into tippers/dumpers by deploying crawler mounted hydraulic excavator. • Transportation of ROM (Iron Ore) to the designated stockpile by tippers/dumpers at an average lead dist ance of 0.90 Km via weighbridge. • Installation of 60 Te weighing Capacity pitless weighbridge to weigh empty and loaded tippers/dumpers. • Unloading of ROM at designated stockpile & leveling. • Water sprinkling on the 0.90 Km haul road from mining pit to designated stockpile.
